# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty years of age  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c27 P10](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Cook and homemaker  <sub>[v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027), [v1 c27 P2](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza is a tall woman with a slender frame and sharp angles rather than soft curves. Her silvering dark hair is kept bound tightly at the back in a firm bun fastened by wire hairpins. With age, her cheek has become lined and withered, and her hands are calloused and rough from years of labor. Though her failing eyesight threatened total blindness, it stabilized with medical care, though it remains permanently limited.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 c34 P7](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0007), [v2 c6 P24](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0024), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c12 P39](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0039), [v2 c14 P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 c15 P43](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0043)_

## Personality

Thirza is a practical, rational, and composed woman with an unyielding sense of morality and duty. She is strict and critical in raising children, often attaching moral lessons to her words, yet she possesses a underlying sense of humor and deep, reserved affection. She refuses on principle to express opinions about ministers and dislikes fancy trimmings or foolish daydreams. Over time, her stern nature grows noticeability softer and more mellow.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c5 P12](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0012), [v1 c7 P19](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0019), [v1 c8 P41](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0041), [v1 c8 P44](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0044), [v1 c21 P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004), [v1 c21 P26](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0026), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046), [v2 c7 P31](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0031)_

## History

Thirza lived at Grey Shutters in Brierley with her brother Obed Abernethy for decades, maintaining a remarkably neat household. They requested a young boy from an asylum, but due to a misunderstanding, a young orphan girl named Nell Harcourt arrived instead. Though initially intending to return her, Thirza grew deeply fond of Nell and decided to raise her. Over the years, Thirza raised Nell with strict discipline, moral lessons, and quiet love, supporting her through her schooling. Following Obed's sudden death from a heart condition, Thirza and Nell relied on each other, and Thirza sought medical help in town to preserve her failing eyesight. She later took in her distant young cousins, the orphaned Farrow twins, Robin and Lucy, maintaining her tradition of strictly raising them. As time passed, Thirza's temperament noticeably softened and mellowed.

## Background by volume

- Moved to Grey Shutters after reaching adulthood  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Recalled being called a dark, homely little thing by her aunt during childhood  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Inherited an amethyst brooch from her mother  <sub>[v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>
- Close friends and potential suitor with John Carrow during their youth  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)</sub>
- Raised by her father to refrain from sending children to school before age seven  <sub>[v2 c10 P86](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0086)</sub>
